identifier.value: San Francisco Bay Area DevOps Companies
University of California Berkeley Alumni Founded Companies

org_similarity_list.target_short_description: Incident.io provides incident management software that helps teams detect, manage, and resolve issues through Slack and Teams.
Rootly provides incident management solutions designed to streamline operations and reduce response times for organizations.
PagerDuty is an operations performance platform that helps monitor IT infrastructure, detect issues, and resolve incidents.
BigPanda is a software development firm that offers IT Ops, NOC, and DevOps teams to detect, investigate, and resolve IT incidents.
FireHydrant, Inc provides an all-in-one alerting, on-call, and incident management platform for engineering and reliability teams.
OpsLevel is an internal developer portal (IDP) that empowers engineering teams to quickly build and ship high-quality software.
Dynatrace is an observability platform that monitors applications, infrastructure, and experience using AI-driven analytics for enterprises.
ServiceNow is an AI platform that delivers IT operations, field service management and app engine solutions.
Coralogix is a SaaS platform that uses machine learning algorithms to facilitate delivery and maintenance processes for software providers.
xMatters is a digital service availability platform that prevents issues from becoming business problems.
Splunk is a software company that provides operational intelligence software that monitors, reports, and analyzes real-time machine data.
Atlassian is a software company that offers proprietary software products for teamwork, project management, and software development.

overview_description.description:
Struct automatically root causes eng alerts (ex. Sentry, Datadog) and bugs using context from your logs, metrics, and traces. 

It's already investigating thousands of on-call issues per month for companies like Fermat and Arcana, cutting on-call context switching and resolution time.

It only takes about 15 minutes to get set up and try out our free tier: it's already integrated into your existing tech stack, and fully HIPAA and SOC2 compliant.
